weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，今天是做夢的完美日子！把握機會拓寬視野，探索新的可能性，因為這將豐富您的見識。花點時間放鬆一下，也許可以躺下來，仰望天空的雲朵或星星。讓您的想像力遨遊到看似遙不可及或無法企及的境界。請記住，許多實際的成就都是從夢想的種子萌芽而來的。 給自己這段寶貴的思考時間，培養您的創造力。
aries.horoscope_en: Today is a perfect day for dreaming, Aries! Embrace the opportunity to broaden your horizons and explore new possibilities, as this will enrich your understanding. Take a moment to unwind—perhaps lie back and gaze at the clouds or stars above. Allow your imagination to wander into realms that might seem far-fetched or unattainable. Remember, many tangible achievements have sprung from the seeds of dreams. Nurture your creativity by giving yourself this precious time to reflect.
aries.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，今天請擁抱周圍的活力能量，讓您的想像力盡情飛揚。這種創造性的探索將加深您與內在自我的連結，並釋放您的藝術潛能。您會發現，當您的思緒可以自由馳騁時，您的解決問題能力會更加出色。請記住，您富有想像力的一面與您感性的一面同樣重要，所以請好好善用它！
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, embrace the vibrant energy around you and allow your imagination to soar. This creative exploration will deepen your connection with your inner self and unlock your artistic potential. You'll find that your problem-solving abilities shine brighter when your mind is free to wander. Remember, this imaginative side of you is just as vital as your emotional heart, so make the most of it!
taurus.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

gemini.horoscope: 今天可能有機會認識一位新朋友，雙子座。您天生有能力讓他人感到自在，無論他們有什麼不同，這點確實令人讚嘆。您擁抱多元性，這種開放的態度讓您與眾不同。如果可以的話，請安排與這位新朋友或其他您重視的人共度時光。您會發現許多人渴望與您共度時光。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today could bring the chance to connect with a new friend, Gemini. Your natural ability to make others feel at ease, regardless of their differences, is truly remarkable. You embrace diversity, and this open-mindedness sets you apart from the crowd. If you can, arrange to spend time with this new acquaintance or another cherished individual. You'll find that many are eager to share their time with you.
gemini.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，您的想像力實在令人驚豔！今天是發揮這種創造力的絕佳機會。花些時間從事藝術活動，無論是透過冥想、創作故事、角色扮演，還是具體想像您的目標。這是面對內心恐懼與限制的有效方式，既能提升您的自信與創造力，又能幫助您克服生活中的障礙。 如果您對這個概念還不熟悉，不妨進一步探索冥想，以加深您與內在自我的連結。
cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, your imagination is truly remarkable! Today presents a wonderful opportunity to harness that creativity. Dedicate some time to artistic pursuits, whether it's through meditation, crafting stories, role-playing, or visualizing your goals. This is a potent way to confront your inner fears and limitations, boosting both your confidence and creativity while helping you tackle life's obstacles. If you're new to this concept, think about exploring meditation further to deepen your connection with your inner self.
cancer.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

leo.horoscope: 獅子座，今天您可能會感覺到力量和自信的激增。這是走出舒適圈並展開新冒險的完美時刻。如果您希望看到某種改變，您可能正是促成這種改變的催化劑。無論是競選公職，還是到其他地方擔任領導職務，現在都是您大放異彩的時刻。您的影響力和個人魅力確實能產生有意義的影響。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you're likely to feel a surge of strength and confidence. This is the perfect moment to step out of your comfort zone and embark on a new adventure. If there's a change you wish to see, you might just be the catalyst for it. Whether it's running for office or stepping into a leadership position elsewhere, now is your time to shine. Your influence and charisma can truly create a meaningful impact.
leo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天氛圍對您有利，讓您心情愉悅，一整天都充滿喜悅。您會有很多歡笑的時刻，這不僅能讓您自己心情愉悅，也能鼓舞周圍的人。您散播正能量的能力確實令人讚嘆。透過分享您的微笑與歡笑來擁抱這股能量，讓真實的自我閃耀光芒。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, the vibes are in your favor, lifting your mood and filling your day with joy. Expect plenty of laughter, which not only brightens your own spirits but also inspires those around you. Your ability to spread positivity is truly remarkable. Embrace this energy by sharing your smiles and laughter, and let your authentic self shine.
virgo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，您今天可能會發現自己越來越受歡迎。這是推動一些正面變革的絕佳機會。如果您和同事認為新的計畫（例如提高福利）能讓工作場所受益，不妨主動向負責人提出這些想法。即使過去曾提出過類似的提案，您也可以利用自己新獲得的影響力來爭取支持，或集思廣益，提出創新策略，以增強團隊凝聚力。
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, you may find your popularity on the rise. This is a perfect opportunity to initiate some positive changes. If you and your colleagues believe that your workplace could benefit from new initiatives, like enhanced benefits, consider stepping up to present these ideas to those in charge. Even if similar proposals have been made in the past, leverage your newfound influence to rally support or brainstorm innovative strategies to enhance group dynamics.
libra.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，今天宇宙的氛圍將您的魅力和吸引力展露無遺。您會發現自己的熱情和對生活的熱愛變得更加強烈，吸引他人進入您的生活圈。人們很可能會欽佩您，並向您尋求指引。人氣的飆升可能會讓您充滿獨特感和幸運感。不過，請小心不要讓它讓您的自我膨脹。保持腳踏實地，並將這股正能量引導至鼓舞他人。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, the cosmic vibes are shining a spotlight on your charm and appeal. You'll find your enthusiasm and zest for life amplified, attracting others to your orbit. It's likely that people will admire you and seek your guidance. This surge in popularity can fill you with a sense of uniqueness and fortune. However, be cautious not to let it inflate your ego. Stay grounded and channel this positive energy towards uplifting others.
scorpio.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，今天對您來說將是一個令人振奮的好日子。普遍的能量將使您能夠輕鬆做出明智的選擇。預期事情的進展速度會比平常快。您將從同事的支持、體力活力的提升以及敏銳的智力中受益。您還能奢求什麼呢？看來運氣站在您這邊，快樂將伴隨您度過一整天。 花點時間肯定自己的成就，因為您完全有能力處理所有遇到的事情。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today is set to be a wonderfully uplifting day for you, Sagittarius. The prevailing energy will empower you to make wise choices with ease. Expect things to progress at a faster pace than normal. You'll benefit from the support of your coworkers, a boost in physical vitality, and a keen intellect. What more could you desire? It seems that luck is on your side, and joy will accompany you throughout the day. Take a moment to acknowledge your achievements, as you’re more than capable of managing everything that comes your way.
sagittarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，今天請謹言慎行。您周圍的能量強調了謹慎溝通的必要性。花點時間想想您的言論可能會對聽者產生什麼影響。您很容易在措辭上失誤，特別是在傳達可能不被接受的消息時。避免發表可能被解讀為個人批評的言論；相反，請專注於行為而非個人。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, Capricorn, choose your words wisely. The energy surrounding you emphasizes the need for careful communication. Take a moment to consider how your remarks might impact the listener. It's particularly easy to misstep in your phrasing, especially if you're delivering news that may not be well-received. Steer clear of remarks that could be interpreted as personal criticism; focus instead on the actions rather than the individual.
capricorn.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，今天您可能會覺得很難投入工作。您的思緒可能更傾向於白日夢而非現實，帶領您踏上充滿想像力的旅程。為了重新集中注意力，不妨試著列出您需要處理的任務清單。這將有助您實現眼前的目標，讓您在今晚稍晚能夠放鬆身心。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, today you might find it challenging to dive into your work. Your mind may wander more towards daydreams than reality, leading you on imaginative journeys. To regain your focus, try jotting down a list of tasks you need to tackle. This will assist you in achieving your immediate goals, allowing you to unwind and relax later this evening.
aquarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

pisces.horoscope: 今天，您可能會注意到別人以友善的方式被您吸引。這種魅力源自您與生俱來的傾聽能力，以及您對不同觀點的開放態度。花點時間觀察您周圍的人；可能有人需要一個願意傾聽的對象。有時候，只要一點鼓勵，就能讓別人願意分享自己的想法。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, you might notice that others are drawn to you in a friendly way. This charm stems from your natural ability to listen and your openness to different perspectives. Take a moment to observe those around you; there may be someone who could benefit from a sympathetic ear. Sometimes, all it takes is a little encouragement to get someone to share their thoughts.
